Class Student

java.lang.Object
internshipPlacementManagementSystem.User
internshipPlacementManagementSystem.Student
All Implemented Interfaces:
java.io.Serializable
public class Student
extends User
implements java.io.Serializable
Student User applying to and being placed into Internships This class can Apply to internships, monitor their applications and their status, and if needed withdraw applications they have previously made
